mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_members (trip_plan_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES (#{tripPlanId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS user_id, u.email AS email, u.nickname AS nickname, m.role AS role, m.status AS status, m.created_at AS created_at FROM trip_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.trip_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
SELECT id, trip_plan_id, user_id, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM trip_members WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'

SELECT m.trip_plan_id AS planId, p.title AS planTitle, owner.nickname AS inviterNickname, m.role AS role, m.created_at AS invitedAt FROM trip_members m JOIN trip_plans p ON p.id = m.trip_plan_id JOIN users owner ON owner.id = p.owner_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
